title: Comfortable, But Doesn't Quite Fit
text: Comfortable, But Doesn't Quite Fit. We are in desperate need of a new mattress, but we're trying to delay that expense for the time being. I thought a memory foam topper might be a good temporary solution. It arrived compressed and expanded when the plastic covering was removed. There were no foul odors like some foam or plastic products. The mattress cover that comes with it is very nice and much better than the mattress cover I was using before. The cover easily fits over the topper and the mattress. Our bed is a regular king size, but this does not fit it. It hangs over the edge on one side and doesn't meet the edge of the other side. We turned it thinking that might be the problem, but we still had the same issues. Sleeping is very comfortable and it actually provided more cushion so when I turned during the night, my sore knee didn't hurt as much as it usually does. Another thing that I liked was that I didn't notice my husband's tossing and turning as much either. I struggled with how many stars to give it. I do like it, but the fact that it doesn't fit my bed is kind of annoying.
